        white_pos = n['boundary'][0]  # [row, col]
        break

blue_squares = []
for n in seg['nodes']:

                center = n['boundary'][0]  # approximate
                if child['color'] == 'Y':
                    yellow_squares.append((center[0], center[1], n['id']))
                elif child['color'] == 'b':
                    blue_squares.append((center[0], center[1], n['id']))
print(f"Yellow squares: {yellow_squares}")
print(f"Blue squares: {blue_squares}")

# Try moving UP more to see if we can reach the yellow cross area

result = action(['UP'])

for n in seg2['nodes']:

        print(f"After UP: player at {n['boundary'][0]}")
        break
